game.runtime_binding_policy: For the observed game 1.0.11 executable, owner RVA 0x94F4FA8 and key member offset +0x128 are a zero-scan fast path only. If validation against the active .db fails during FullActivation, runtime permits at most one current-EXE structural scan. It scans only executable section bytes bounded by min(SizeOfRawData, VirtualSize), counts only valid unique targets inside SizeOfImage, and shares one total budget of at most 24 active-database key validations across packaged and structural owner routes. Structural incompatibility fails closed, and this is not a compatibility promise for every future game version.

scene_presentation.rendering_cost_policy: Scene updates every existing EngineTickPost frame. Eight or more selected markers use five engine calibration points checking both depth axes, plus one actual retained-marker witness within a radial 0.25 physical-pixel tolerance. Calibration is frame-local; no previous camera pose is reused or interpolated. Unsupported, orthographic, missing-camera or mismatched calibration uses native per-marker projection. Exceptional engine faults retain the existing Scene isolation path. Moving groups use volatile painting and disable pixel snapping when the reflected engine enum is available. Every changed subpixel render translation is submitted; unchanged positions reuse state. Edge margins are 52 pixels for new / 44 for retained markers, overlap spacing 40 / 32. Catalog selection remains 250 ms and selected-distance refresh is bounded to 50 points. No measured FPS or latency improvement is claimed.
scene_presentation.f6_preview_policy: F6-owned cursor preview is limited to the settings Hub actually owning its input mode and the native HUD remaining visible. Scene may preview current settings while that owned menu is open; the existing enable, readiness, world/travel, activity, native-menu and HUD guards remain authoritative. Other cursor ownership never grants this exception. Scene creates no new input hook.

configuration.visibility_config: Startup-only config/visibility.ini, at most 4096 bytes. Current serialization/public defaults contain six complete sections: [radar], [map], [scene], [modes], [height_arrows], [interface]. Scene treasure, area_quests and mini_games default true; range_meters=600 (0..1000), marker_limit=24 (0..50), distance_mode=nearest_center (off/central_radius/nearest_center/all). Either zero numeric setting suppresses Scene; distance off suppresses labels only. All five height keys treasure/area_quests/mole/boss/assault default true. Interface language defaults auto and remains persisted. The reader preserves strict legacy packed schema 1-4 and old three/five-section files; absent new fields use defaults while existing explicit choices survive. A present legacy Scene section still requires its original treasure and area_quests keys. Unknown, duplicate, malformed or incomplete required legacy input fails closed. No hot polling; F6 never rewrites hotkeys.ini.
configuration.settings_close_policy: When a confirmation is active, Esc cancels only that modal and keeps F6 open. Its held/repeat/release tail remains consumed. A second F6, forced page close or focus loss closes the whole page and clears pending confirmation without dispatching it; focus loss takes priority over Escape. Without a confirmation, Esc, Close and a second F6 sample final controls, including the slider's last drag value, then close F6 and flush changed settings. Null current-controller probes during close/cancel resolve the host owner, while actual controller replacement fails closed. Travel and teardown clear pending intent and weak records. Source/isolated input tests are separate from game acceptance.
configuration.diagnostics_config: startup-only config/diagnostics.ini; public default debug_logging=false; enabled log schema 2 records seq, utc_ms, and elapsed_ms; disabled path returns before formatting, mutex acquisition, directory creation, rotation, or file I/O

f6_layout.global_preset: Bottom-row Reset to Defaults first opens a Yes/No confirmation. Only confirmed Yes restores all legal Radar/Map/Scene categories on, all five height choices on, both filters to Available, Scene 600 m/24/Aim and language AUTO. No or Esc closes only the confirmation with unchanged source settings. Confirmed restoration uses normal final-control sampling and one atomic global_reset_requested result; pending Scene writes flush even if values already match, while unchanged controls with no pending writes cause no write. Radar running state, startup hotkeys, saves and gameplay state are unchanged.
f6_layout.skin_policy: SG-12 keeps restrained blue-gray translucent cards and square Radar/Map checks. The fixed header is 98 reference units and footer 58; the intervening four-card body scrolls on short displays. Minimum supported viewport is 640x360. At 720p the main controls keep reference size; 21:9 adds side margins without stretching. While open, viewport/DPI checks run every 250 ms and update the retained tree without texture reimports, preserving settings and scroll position. Resize cancels pending confirmations before changing geometry. Invalid dimensions follow normal final-setting sampling and close. Numeric layout tests cover 83 cases; game input/composition remains unverified.
f6_layout.tooltip_policy: Native UWidget:SetToolTip manages 32 short help topics across 56 owners in the bounded 64-record pool. Eleven shared 640x7632 atlases contain 32 help, seven confirmation and fourteen numeric/symbol tiles each, totaling 583 tiles. Language edges replace the atlas; steady hover does not import or discover resources. Confirmation crops and numeric crops share the same regular-font pixels. Resize updates retained tooltip geometry as well as the page. Missing confirmation resources disable Yes; close/travel clear weak ownership.
f6_layout.scene_preview_policy: F6-owned cursor preview is limited to the settings Hub actually owning its input mode and the native HUD remaining visible. Scene may preview current settings while that owned menu is open; the existing enable, readiness, world/travel, activity, native-menu and HUD guards remain authoritative. Other cursor ownership never grants this exception. Scene creates no new input hook.
f6_layout.confirmation_contract: Reset to Defaults, Vote for This Mod and Feedback each ask one localized question. Yes consumes the armed intent once before resetting display preferences or opening the fixed Nexus home/Posts URL. No or Esc cancels only the modal; focus loss closes the whole page. Background input remains blocked through dismissal and resize. Voting means Mod of the Month voting, distinct from endorsement; opening the mod page never submits a vote or feedback.
f6_layout.language_simplification: SG-12 standardizes regular fonts and concise wording in all eleven languages. Reset to Defaults, Vote for This Mod and Feedback share a fixed footer. The 760x852 reference panel scrolls its four-card body on short displays and reflows the retained tree after viewport/DPI changes. Scene uses current-frame calibrated projection with native fallback, changed subpixel translations and visibility hysteresis. Existing catalogs, height rules, distance corrections and display defaults remain. Local deployment is authorized; release packages are deferred until owner testing.
f6_layout.sg12_h1_opening_fix: SG-12-H1 fixes F6 failing to open in deployed SG-12. The two reflected UScrollBox parameter names are corrected to NewOrientation and NewScrollBarVisibility; type, offset and size checks remain. Two negative source checks cover these names, bringing the Hub regression suite from six to eight. All 61 UI files match SG-12 byte-for-byte. Local deployment only; release packages remain deferred until owner testing.
f6_layout.sg12_h2_opening_fix: SG-12-H2 addresses the remaining F6 opening failure observed after H1. Live H1 diagnostics report the ScrollBox ABI failure bit (1073741824), and a live UE4SS reflection probe confirms that /Script/UMG.ScrollBox:SetScrollBarVisibility is absent in this game. H2 treats that visual setter as optional: validate it independently when present, clear it when absent or incompatible, and call it only when valid. Required ScrollBox, layout and content ABI checks remain strict. Two additional negative cases bring the Hub suite from eight to ten. All 61 UI files and other behavior are retained. Local deployment only; no new release packages.

configuration.hotkeys_config: startup-only config/hotkeys.ini; three distinct single-key bindings; invalid runtime config falls back as a whole to F6/F7/F8; Setup reads existing bindings and allows confirmed selections on Install, Update, and Repair; unchanged selections preserve exact bytes, changed values preserve comments and formatting, other user settings are preserved; invalid or duplicate keys and stale confirmations reject before mutation; failures roll back old keys; no F6 save or live reload
configuration.settings_escape_input_policy: F6 opens only after verifying the foreground UnrealWindow, current-process ownership and nonzero thread, then installing hooks on that one local window thread. WH_GETMESSAGE changes owned-window/child Escape key, repeat, release and character messages to WM_NULL before TranslateMessage/DispatchMessage; WH_CALLWNDPROC only observes owner focus, activation and destruction. The consumed press remains owned after UMG closes through key-up; the next independent press resumes normal routing. Synchronous focus loss requests full close and clears the held gesture while retaining protection until actual UMG removal. Travel, owner destruction and teardown clear state; process shutdown disables ingress without Unreal access. Hook failure rejects opening with failure 40. No global/low-level keyboard hook, synthetic input, UObject call or object scan occurs in this module. Other keys and other windows remain outside the filter scope.
configuration.compact_clock_presentation: SG-09 uses the existing one-hertz minimap layout service for dynamic Clock placement; it introduces no new object scan. An at-most-eight-step owner walk must resolve the exact main panel and its DLayerMiniMap backlink. Completed Slate geometry from LayerMap.RetainerBox and main.DLayerQuest is converted through LocalToAbsolute into the fixed host root with AbsoluteToLocal. With a gap of at least 30 reference units, visible paint ancestry within 24 steps and valid host/viewport bounds, clock left is minimapCenterX minus 58 times scale and top is the midpoint of minimapBottom and questTop minus 15 times scale. This centers the visible ink at reference Y=15, not the 42-unit container center. The container remains 116x42. Missing properties or unvalidated geometry ABI, invalid/rotated geometry, hidden paint, insufficient gap or out-of-bounds placement uses the original minimap-center plus 178-reference-unit fallback. A resize defers reading old Slate geometry for that service pass. Slot position changes only when cumulative displacement from the last applied position exceeds 0.25 reference units. SG-12 retains this Clock behavior; Core 9/9 includes Clock 28/0. Native 446/446 and the source/release gates pass. Earlier SG-10 results remain historical; owner in-game placement acceptance is pending.
